accepted_design.FPL_expiry: Separate optional slot, strict versioned Comment with explicit operator-supplied future aware UTC expires_at. Missing, malformed or expired metadata blocks before decoding; recheck at actual authenticated send after pacing or retry. No inferred JWT authority, invented TTL, extraction or renewal. Retain explicit existing large-token mechanism when vault size cannot fit.
accepted_design.authorization_order: Source/profile/quota and exact runtime approval, durable reservation, child claim and scope validation precede resolution. Remove parent CurrentRefreshSession.prepare secret-value availability check. Native adapters are lazily imported inside explicit setup/status/delete or authorized child acquisition only.
accepted_design.codec: Use string input to reviewed public facade, strict UTF16LE blob decode on read. Odds token policy remains existing16..512 ASCII chars; enforce raw32..1024 even bytes. FPL separate max2560 raw bytes, no truncation. Do not expect CredentialBlobSize in facade dictionary.
accepted_design.error_boundary: Safe typed missing, unavailable, corrupt, expired, busy and input errors; suppress native values and recursively inspect error chains in tests. Reuse accepted outer-frame sanitization rather than relying solely on from None.
accepted_design.mutation_lock: Bounded monotonic msvcrt byte-range lock on one nonsensitive retained byte in current-user LOCALAPPDATA/dmf-pulse/control. No secret content and no TEMP fallback. Inherit trusted user-profile ACL; Python mode bits do not establish Windows ACL isolation. Prompt before lock, recheck existence inside lock, hold through set/delete, close on every exit. Do not delete lock file on release. Coordinates Pulse callers only.
accepted_design.native_identity: Fixed app-owned case-insensitive target mapping, generic type1, PERSIST_LOCAL_MACHINE2, flags0; same current Windows user and computer across logons, no ENTERPRISE roaming. Never enumerate all targets.
accepted_design.precedence: Root agreed explicit nonsecret DMF_ODDS_CREDENTIAL_SOURCE=environment selects legacy session-only environment. Otherwise Windows auto is vault-only and Linux auto is existing systemd-only. Corrupt, unavailable or expired vault entries never trigger fallback. Read actual environment value only at authorized get, not constructor or presence checks.
accepted_design.replacement: Existing entry requires explicit --replace. CredWrite replaces by name and type and is not atomic create-only; the cross-process lock is required for project create/check/write semantics. Readers may see complete prior or new records around authorized rotation; no same-user global exclusivity claim.
accepted_design.status: Only explicit CLI status may read exact native record. The maintained facade copies blob bytes even without decoding; honestly state no decode/display, not no secret read. Dashboard opening and demo never query status. Stored presence does not prove key validity or source rights.
accepted_design.threat_model: OS user-scoped protected persistence, not application isolation, Credential Guard protection for generic secrets, defence against malicious same-user code/admin, or guaranteed Python memory erasure. No real credential inspection by agents; native test touches only newly created synthetic UUID slot.
accepted_design.wire_auth: Use existing api.the-odds-api.com accepted transport. Required transient apiKey query authentication on encrypted wire is not a saved/logged/browser URL; do not substitute another similarly named provider or unsupported header auth.

authority.conclusion: No genuine conflict. Current explicit user request authorizes a minimal Windows native credential integration; existing Linux systemd stays intact. Credential possession or setup never authorizes provider access, recurring use, retention, account entitlement or a live pilot. FND001 dependency limits describe that earlier foundation scope; do not treat them as a ban on this explicitly requested reviewed platform adapter.
decision_locators: ADR-ASSUR-002 PROVISIONAL, not ACCEPTED: systemd credentials

dependency.backend_selection: Upstream prefers cffi if available. Frozen native acceptance must identify and exercise intended ctypes backend; no keyring plugin discovery, plaintext backend or extra implicit dependency.
dependency.python313_native_support: NOT_ESTABLISHED_BY_METADATA; mandatory actual installed Windows proof
dependency.review_disposition: Reasonable minimal candidate for bounded implementation, not a claim of certified3.13 support or a maintenance guarantee. Pin exact source/artifact provenance and review licence notice.

mandatory_acceptance.acceptance: Import, provider construction, dashboard opening, --help and all demo paths touch no vault, secret environment value, provider, database or native integration import.
Missing rights, revoked or expired approval, wrong exact scope and exhausted quota fail before vault reads; current worker validates and claims the durable grant before any lookup.

Windows auto uses vault only; explicit environment mode reads value only at authorized get. Linux auto keeps systemd. Both-present, missing, corrupt, unavailable and expired cases follow exact documented selection; no hidden fallback.

Existing Odds16..512 ASCII token validator is reused. Valid ASCII tokens round-trip through facade UTF16LE, raw blob32..1024 even bytes. Malformed bytes, odd size, NUL, nonASCII, whitespace, wrong record shape and oversize reject safely.

Explicit status queries only the exact app target, returns presence or typed unavailability, never decodes or displays blob and never enumerates unrelated credentials. Presence is not validity, rights or account entitlement.
Setup secure prompt hides input and fails closed on unavailable secure console. CLI accepts no secret value arguments; extra secret-shaped arguments and prompt/backend exceptions never echo a canary.

First setup, existing without --replace, explicit replacement and deletion behave correctly. Bounded cross-process mutation lock covers final existence check and mutation; concurrent Pulse setters cannot bypass replacement approval.

Readers during rotation see one complete old or new record; no partial blob. Separate-process tests check crash releases the lock and no stale lockfile deletion race. No global compare-and-swap claim against other same-user programs.
Wrong-user mock namespaces return missing; no-logon1312, access denied and missing dependency become bounded typed errors. No other Windows account or real production vault entry is inspected.

Backend exceptions carrying synthetic canaries are recursively rendered through str, repr, vars, cause, context and traceback checks. No raw key escapes; from None alone is not sufficient context sanitization.

Credential values never enter grants, worker launch IPC, browser payloads, state/report JSON, logs, argv, saved URLs, quota evidence, database or general environment mutation. Only the existing authorized HTTPS wire target contains provider-required auth.

Stored FPL token has separate identity and strict versioned comment with explicit aware UTC expiry. Invalid metadata rejects before decode, exact expiry boundary rejects, pacing/retry boundary is rechecked before authenticated send, and no JWT-derived TTL or renewal is invented.

FPL blob exceeding2560 raw UTF16LE bytes is rejected without truncation. Existing explicit16K environment or hidden-interaction path remains separate, and an expired FPL token never forces reentry or deletion of the saved Odds key.

Linux dependency resolution and package import work without win32 dependency; production systemd symlink, bounded-file and no-env-default behavior remain accepted. No plaintext persistent fallback exists.

Native Windows Python3.13 installed-wheel proof spans separate PowerShell processes: fresh owned UUID namespace setup, production provider resolution without reentry, replacement, deletion and absence. No provider request, real target access or key bytes in evidence.
Native acceptance records actual backend selection and pinned dependency identity. No unsupported claim that upstream classifiers or an in-process mock prove Python3.13 support.

Existing one- and three-GW owned actual application outputs and all numerical/rules/dataset identities remain exact under controlled provenance; full security, import, wheel, typing, migrations, coverage and20 exact-final-SHA CI gates pass.

primary_document_receipts.supports: Generic application blob,5*512 byte maximum, case-insensitive target, LOCAL_MACHINE persistence across this same user and computer logons; ENTERPRISE may roam.
Current token logon credential set, exact target read, missing1168 and unavailable logon1312, returned native buffer must be freed.
Creates or replaces exact target and type; no atomic create-only or compare-and-swap guarantee.
Exact current-user target deletion; missing and unavailable logon errors; flags0.
Generic credentials are application-managed and readable by user processes; no process-isolation or same-user malware protection claim.
Windows Credential Manager delegates encrypted persistence to Windows; collect late, do not log, use HTTPS. Python cannot guarantee buffer erasure.
Lines53-60 public facade encodes a Unicode buffer, hence UTF16LE on Windows; lines78-87 read back raw blob bytes. Public dict omits CredentialBlobSize and LastWritten.
Generic-only facade, native read and enumeration copy blobs into dicts, native memory freed, CredWrite flags0.
Backend chooses cffi if available, otherwise ctypes; import modifies meta_path, so defer all native integration imports to explicit operations.
Latest published0.2.3, no declared runtime dependencies, pure Python wheel, >=3.6 metadata; Python classifiers end3.11, not proof of3.13 native support.
BSD3Clause permits distribution with required notices; record dependency provenance.
Correct api.the-odds-api.com v4 provider uses apiKey query authentication on wire; preserve transient transport-only target and sanitized public URLs.

release_limit: This is a design assessment, not final implementation clearance, native acceptance success, provider authority, permission to inspect a real key, human acceptance, model promotion or production activation.
research_limit: Public primary documentation and versioned source only; no provider endpoint, account, vault inventory, credential value or native secret API was accessed. Some direct GitHub workflow/main API reads returned cache errors; do not claim unseen upstream3.13 CI.
